en.Dois milhões de células de sangue novas,: This body of yours makes two million new blood cells every second! And the ending is the craziest part.
en.Elas nascem dentro dos seus ossos, no tu: They're born inside your bones, in the marrow. Follow Maia, there's more:
en.pra levar mais oxigênio, ela joga fora o: to carry more oxygen, the red blood cell throws out its nucleus and lives with no DNA.
en.De cada dez células suas, umas oito são: Out of every ten cells in you, about eight are these. By count, you're mostly blood!
